blocks.title: What Samsung memory is
blocks.text: Samsung Electronics is a conglomerate (phones, TVs, appliances, chips). Its Device Solutions (DS) division holds Memory, System LSI and Foundry; Memory (DRAM, HBM, NAND/SSD) is the largest of the three. Group totals here are OpenDART consolidated filings; Memory revenue is the 'Sales by business' row of the quarterly IR deck; DS revenue and operating income are from the results releases. Samsung does not report memory operating income or HBM revenue, so those appear only as estimates.
